@Delivery colleagues: User has reported that the link from Receipt to the Same Tender Card is prompting the user to enter the Account Number. Example Account Number: 1027150660344994. Details below:

prepare prepared_query(BIGINT,INT,TEXT) as

SELECT 
T1.StoreNo AS "storeno", 
T1.CashierNo AS "cashierno", 
T1.EndTransDateTime AS "endtransdatetime", 
T1.POSNo AS "posno", 
T1.TicketNo AS "ticketno", 
T1.TicketAmount AS "ticketamount", 
T1.VoidTicketFlg AS "voidticketflg", 
T1.TransactionID AS "transactionid"
FROM ardm_Header AS T1
WHERE 
(
(T1.TradingDay BETWEEN CAST('2024-01-04T00:00:00' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-02-03T23:59:59' AS DATE))
)
AND
(
(T1.StoreNo = $2 AND T1.CashierNo = $3)
AND 
(T1.TransactionID = $1)
)
ORDER BY "endtransdatetime" DESC
LIMIT 1000;

execute prepared_query(2501250000099232966,561,'005610000351083');
deallocate prepared_query;

When the above search is run, we can see the transaction as:

Clicking on the highlighted card link above, we can see the following:

Given the aforementioned, the user is expecting the same tender card results to appear without the prompt above. Would request if you can review and assist further on this. Thankyou!

The searches are different between QA and production. I will list the differences below:

  1. Account Number is an Optional Parameter in QA, Mandatory in Production

  2. Production has the Appriss Transaction ID header field

  3. Production has the Appriss Transaction Type header field

  4. Production has the Tender Account number field

  5. Production has the Customer Full Name Field

The search does not require typing the parameter in QA, but does in production.

Attempting to make qa exactly like production results in the following:

I also wish to point out that the html of the receipts is identical between production and qa.
